text:
alex: Heads-up — ACME reporting p95 latency regressions after the 2026-11-08 deploy (~12:05 UTC). Their simple text.generate calls jump from ~600ms to ~1.8s intermittently. They sent a handful of request IDs but we need a proper repro pack (curl samples, promptset, concurrency profile, token counts, logs).

maria: Thanks. Can you paste the customer-provided request IDs and one of their curl calls? Also which model + generation params are they using?

alex: Model: redwood-alpha-13b, sampling top_p=0.95, temp=0.2, max_tokens=512. Avg input length ~420 tokens, concurrency they reported ~40-50 simultaneous clients. Request IDs from the customer: r-03b7a2c4, r-03b7a2c8, r-03b7a2d9, r-03b7a2e3, r-03b7a2fa. Example curl they sent: 

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-13b","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":512,"temperature":0.2}' \
  -H "X-Request-ID: r-03b7a2c4"
```

joel: I'll take the request IDs and run a targeted stress replay on our staging harness. To make the replay faithful I need: the exact prompt set (if they batch multiple prompts), per-request prompt lengths, and a concurrency profile (ramp up, steady, ramp down). Can you ask customer for a small promptset (10-30 prompts) that reproduces the spike and their client concurrency driver script if possible.

alex: Sending them a short repro instruction now. I'll ask them to run our debug bundle endpoint too — that gives us logs + runtime metadata. Command I sent them: 

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/support/debug/bundle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"request_ids":["r-03b7a2c4","r-03b7a2c8","r-03b7a2d9","r-03b7a2e3","r-03b7a2fa"],"include":"client_trace,tokenization,request_body"}'
```

alex: Also asked them to run a quick curl that includes the client concurrency profile (how many concurrent connections and RPS they were seeing). Example they can paste: 

```
siege -c50 -t30S -b "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate Content-Type:application/json,Authorization:Bearer <REDACTED>" <payload_file>
```

emily: One more ask — have them include whether they use caching or client-side retries, and whether they saw any 502/5xx around the same times. Also request their tokenization hash (we can diff for subword boundary issues). If they can attach a small HAR or a curl id->raw payload mapping that'd be ideal.

maria: For our side: I'll check the infra traces for the listed request IDs once the debug bundle arrives. If this is a batching backlog or KV cache pressure issue we'd expect correlated worker queue spikes. Joel — when you run the stress replay, try two variants: (A) exact timing/concurrency, (B) same RPS but randomized interarrival to see whether burstiness is the trigger.

joel: Got it. I'll schedule the replay and attach the replay plan to this thread. Plan will include: promptset (10), token distribution histogram, concurrency ramp steps (10->50 over 30s), and exact headers.

deploy-bot: prod deploy redwood-api@2026-11-08T12:03:22Z — rollout complete :white_check_mark: (revision d4f7c3b)

alex: Noted deploy time — matches customer spike window. Asking them to send the debug bundle and HAR now. Once we have the bundle I'll upload it to the incident bucket and tag it for infra + runtime. Will paste the support-ticket link here. :thumbsup:

emily: If we see model-side stalls, also remind SRE to check GPU utilization and GC pauses on the runtime nodes. Small pauses can amplify p95 for many concurrent requests.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll update when the customer returns the bundle. If they can't run the bundle we asked for, next step is to request a 1:1 remote session and run a live capture.

joel: thumbs-up, standing by to run replays as soon as we have promptset + payloads.

alex: Closing loop — asked customer to include their account/billing id in the bundle (just in case auth/billing throttles are contributing). Follow-up ETA: 2 hours.
